source.inspectionScope: Fresh complete36-line two-file owned patch read. Fixed document menu.css link, Account Hub import and actual shadow-root stylesheet consumer checked. Existing popup browser task directly opens submenu and observes ariaPressed, but was not executed. Gecko menu CSS/DOM changes are related upstream context, not a new paired-Gecko source audit; not a claim all contexts were repaired.
